sources.subtitle: Connect and collect the signals that ground every diagnosis. A connected source is not the same as available data — only a usable snapshot counts.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.subtitle: Run the five-domain diagnostic, then review each finding against its evidence.
diagnosis.needsCrawl: A completed site crawl is required before diagnosis. Collect a crawl snapshot in Sources first.
diagnosis.needsContext: A complete ICP context is required before diagnosis. Finish the project context first.
diagnosis.runActive: A diagnostic run is already in progress for this project.
diagnosis.runError: The diagnostic run did not finish. Review the run status and try again.
diagnosis.ruleBoardEmpty: The rule board populates after the first diagnostic run.
diagnosis.ruleNotRunHint: This rule did not run — its inputs were unavailable.
diagnosis.notDiagnosedHint: Run the diagnosis to surface findings and their evidence.
diagnosis.noFindingsHint: The diagnostic run completed and found nothing that needs attention.
diagnosis.autoNote: Flagged as needs more data automatically because confidence is low.
diagnosis.reasonHelp: Explain why this finding is being ignored (at least 3 characters).
diagnosis.noteHelp: Describe what additional data is needed (at least 3 characters).
diagnosis.reasonTooShort: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
diagnosis.noteTooShort: Enter a note of at least 3 characters.
diagnosis.reviewConflict: This finding was updated elsewhere. We reloaded it — review the latest version and try again.
diagnosis.reviewError: We couldn't save your review. Please try again.

plan.title: Plan
plan.subtitle: Sequence confirmed actions into a 30 / 60 / 90-day roadmap. Windows come from deterministic priority — adjust any of them with a recorded reason.
plan.laneEmpty: No actions scheduled in this window yet.
plan.blockedExplanation: Confidence was too low to schedule this action, so it stays parked here until you collect more data or apply a manual override with a reason.
plan.overrideDescription: Move this action to a different window, priority, or status. A reason is required and written to the audit trail.
plan.overrideKept: Manual overrides are preserved: the next diagnosis will not overwrite this value.
plan.reasonHelp: At least 3 characters. Recorded in the audit trail.
plan.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you making this change?
plan.noteOptional: Optional — extra context for your team.
plan.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
plan.noChange: Choose a new status, priority, or window before applying.
plan.conflict: This action was changed elsewhere. We refreshed the plan — review the current values and try again.
plan.emptyHint: Confirm findings on the Diagnosis screen to build a plan.

studio.title: Studio
studio.subtitle: Generate, edit, and validate the deliverables for each confirmed action, then promote a draft to ready.
studio.runStatusUnavailable: We couldn't refresh the generation status. Artifacts were refreshed; check them before generating again.
studio.generationModeHelp: Template is deterministic; structured LLM drafts richer copy from the same evidence.
studio.operatorInstructionsHelp: Optional guidance for this generation. Steers tone and emphasis; never invents evidence.
studio.editContentHelp: Model output is shown as plain text. Edit here to save a new revision.
studio.markReadyHint: Resolve the validation errors before this artifact can be marked ready.
studio.noRevision: No content yet. Generate this artifact to create the first revision.
studio.staleRevision: This artifact was updated elsewhere. Reloading the latest revision before you continue.
studio.validationFailed: This artifact can't be marked ready yet. Resolve the errors below.
studio.jsonInvalid: Content is not valid JSON. Fix the syntax before saving.
studio.pickActionHelp: Choose a confirmed action to generate its deliverable.
studio.noActions: No actions are ready to execute yet.
studio.emptyHint: Confirm findings and build a plan first.

report.title: Report
report.subtitle: The client-facing view of this engagement: coverage, confirmed findings, the 30/60/90 plan, and ready deliverables.
report.dataCoverageNote: Coverage reflects which signals were available for this analysis. Unavailable data is never estimated or shown as zero.
report.findingsNote: Confirmed findings, each with a client-readable summary and the key evidence behind it.
report.planNote: Recommended actions organized across the 30 / 60 / 90-day horizon.
report.artifactsNote: Ready execution deliverables prepared for this engagement. Drafts are excluded until finalized.
report.noPromise: This report documents observed signals and recommended actions. It does not predict, guarantee, or promise any ranking, traffic, or revenue outcome.
report.clientBundleNote: The client bundle excludes internal observations, notes, provider usage, and unconfirmed findings — only client-safe content is included. The service bundle contains the full internal record.
report.exportAlreadyActive: An export is already being prepared for this project. Wait for it to finish, then refresh the export status.
report.exportDependencyUnavailable: The export service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
report.emptyHint: Run a diagnosis and confirm findings to produce a report.
